property_summary: For any caller address x, when the current owner calls setOwner(newOwner) the owner remains newOwner after the call in the reference (only the current owner can change owner); the mutant inverts the check so a call from the current owner is rejected and thus for some fuzzed inputs (caller equal to current owner) the mutant's behavior differs.
change_summary: Replace require(msg.sender == owner); with require(msg.sender != owner); inverting the check so only non-owners can call guarded functions.
